## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior or document change.
Link the task packet and accepted spec/contract. Identify any changed interface.

## Local evidence

List exact checks, revision, results and relevant devices/runtimes. For behavior,
use the actual HTTP/app boundary. A build or typecheck does not replace E2E.
Documentation-only work checks links, instructions, scope and formatting.

## Handoff

Record remaining decisions/limitations, downstream impact and resources released.
State whether a design is still a draft. Do not attach real health data or secrets.
GitHub Actions usage is exhausted; readiness comes from relevant local evidence.
